rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; healthy control data sourced from four databases: locally recruited Beijing (n=61), FCON-1000 (n=69), Child Connectome Project devCCNP (n=450), Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center (n=269). Combat harmonization applied across datasets to address inter-scanner variability.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases: (i) 61 were locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset; (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP); (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center."

rci2_using_epd.detail: FCON-1000 projects dataset included as one of four healthy control sources
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases: (i) 61 were locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset; (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP); (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center."

rci3_epd_name.detail: FCON-1000 projects dataset used (n=69 healthy children)

rci5_n.detail: 849 healthy children used to build the normative CTh model via Gaussian process regression; pooled from four databases

rci6_sex.detail: Sex breakdown for the 849 healthy control cohort not reported. Gender is mentioned as a covariate in Combat harmonization but no counts provided for HC.

rci7_age.detail: Age statistics for the 849 healthy control cohort not reported. Table 1 provides patient demographics only (mean age 8.4, SD 3.4). The study focuses on pediatric participants but HC age distribution is not described.
